items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Tiny and I from 1945 on we all got very close. Tiny was writing arrangements... he was the most natural musician I've ever known.

ctx.x: He sat, sat in with Dave Allyn when we had a – David Allyn was singing in the band and that’s where I first met David and a lot of us just went right to Boyd Raeburn’s band. Gene DiNovi came into the band at Childs Paramount (restaurant, NY) before that we had Harry Biss, the piano player. And Tiny Kahn came in, played drums, before that we had Ellis Tollin from Philadelphia as the drummer. And a few of us just went right over to Boyd Raeburn’s band in June of that year, we spent about six months with Henry.
This is June of ‘45 you’re talking?
